name: Grish Longrunner
summary: At the Great Lift, Grish Longrunner watches the road between the southern Barrens and Thousand Needles. The tauren scout carries Horde messages and tracks movement across the crossing.

sections.title: Watcher at the Lift
sections.body: Grish Longrunner keeps watch beside the Great Lift in the southern Barrens. Its platform links the dry southern Barrens with the canyons of Thousand Needles. Quilboar packs roam nearby, and rival groups threaten the crossing. Grish watches travelers and keeps the Horde informed, so reinforcements can be sent where they are needed.

faq.answer: Grish Longrunner is a tauren scout for the Horde, watching the rim of the Great Lift. Its platform descends from the Barrens into Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Where can I find Grish Longrunner?
faq.answer: Find Grish Longrunner in the southern Barrens, beside the mechanical entrance to the Great Lift. The platform leads down to Thousand Needles.

faq.q: What role does he play in the area?
faq.answer: Grish receives Horde messengers and travelers. He helps rally and direct local reinforcements through requests such as Calling in the Reserves.

angles.text: As a Horde courier or warrior, you can find Grish watching the Great Lift on the route south to Thousand Needles or north into the Barrens.
As a tauren, you share Grish's Longrunner name and your people's vigilance along the routes through their ancestral lands.
